messages:
cheng: Noticing a regressed p95 on paged-attn workloads after the last runtime change. Overnight nightly shows 1.8ms -> 6.4ms for small-batch chat traces. Root log has a lot of pager churn and repeated KV page loads. :frowning:

maria: Ugh. Is this the change that touched the alloc path + kernel chooser?

cheng: Yeah—deploy from yesterday swapped in the new batcher heuristic + made the allocator prefer smaller slabs for hot shards (to reduce cold-warm cross-talk). Hypothesis: smaller slabs -> more fragmention -> more frequent page re-reads -> backpressure -> kernel switching to fallback FA variant.

alex: Can you paste the repro snippet? I can run perf on my dev box.

cheng: Repro command: `./bench/paged_attn/run.sh --seq 2048 --batch 4 --trace trace-2026-03-15.json --pager-mode=on`. Logs show repeated: `KVPage: load shard=3 page=42 delta=+1 ref=0 miss=1` then `pager: evict page=42 slab=7 reason=frag`.

sam: From earlier threads, when the kernel chooser sees >15% miss rate it forces the FlashAttention-fallback (non-fused) path because it thinks latency will be worse w/ paged kernels. Maybe the miss rate signal is noisy when slab churn happens.

maria: Got a small profile excerpt from the nightly run attached to perf-bot. Perf-bot: `p95_cpu_ms: 6.36, flash_fast_calls: 823, flash_fallback_calls: 4123, kv_page_reads: 28192, kv_evicts: 27400`

cheng: Exactly. The fallback calls ballooned. We need to know whether the allocator churn is primary or the batcher causing tiny batches that increase page pressure.

alex: Quick experiment idea: pin kernels to the fused variant and run bench. If latency stays high then allocator is root. If it drops, kernel chooser was oscillating. I can run pinned kernel in ~20m.

maria: Also want to dump slab metadata per-shard. Add telemetry: `pager.slab_utilization` and `pager.frag_score` (0-1). We saw frag_score ~0.78 on repro shards.

sam: One-off mitigation: increase slab size for hot shards or bump compaction threshold so eviction happens less often. Try `--pager-slab-target=64MB` for the run. That should reduce kv_page_reads.

alex: Running pinned fused kernel + slab-target=64MB now. I'll post numbers when done. :eyes:
note: Slack thread: concise back-and-forth, small code blocks, emoji, perf outputs. No title per agents.md rules.
